_doc: The Sutton Office hub: rooms open on budget milestones, upgrades and car upgrades cost budget points and set flags. Budget comes from verdicts filed at the sorting-room case board. Rooms are interiors of data/maps/sutton_office.json; a room whose opens is not met is a locked facade with gate office_<room>.

counter.name: Front counter
counter.text: Dot's counter. Letters from the public become side cases; the Office phone takes calls during a case.

catalog.name: Card catalog
catalog.text: Every case the Office ever filed, one card each: the quest log, the bestiary, the evidence archive and the verdict history. Drawer S is locked.

sorting.name: Sorting room
sorting.text: The case board between cases. Re-read old evidence, compare cases, file a verdict.

darkroom.name: Darkroom
darkroom.text: Develops film, grades photographs and enlarges a detail into a new clue. Dot unlocks it after the first verdict.

lab.name: Lab
lab.text: The old parcel room. Crafting and sample analysis that would otherwise wait for morning.

radio.name: Radio shack
radio.text: The attic. Logs frequencies heard on the road and in cases; decodes the three-note tone.

bunks.name: Bunk room
bunks.text: Rest, partner downtime and bond level-ups. Dot sleeps here too, so keep it down.

dock.name: Loading dock
dock.text: The garage and the station wagon. Car upgrades are fitted here.

vault.name: Dead letter vault
vault.text: The basement. Undeliverable mail since 1953, letters to people who were not believed. Sealed.

second_line.name: Second phone line
second_line.text: A second line at the counter. Two side cases open at once.

cross_case_board.name: Cross-case board
cross_case_board.text: A second board and more red string. Pin evidence from two cases together.

enlarger.name: Enlarger
enlarger.text: A new bulb and a new lens for the Beseler. One free re-examination of a photograph per case.

spectrometer.name: Spectrometer
spectrometer.text: Surplus from the university, and it works. Identifies red herrings on sight.

roof_antenna.name: Roof antenna
roof_antenna.text: A proper mast on the roof instead of a pipe guyed to a Chevy. Picks up the next case's stations before you leave.

second_bunks.name: Second bunk room
second_bunks.text: The loft over the dock, with beds. Bench partners train while the team is out: half XP becomes full XP.

cb_radio.name: CB radio
cb_radio.text: The CB from the dock bench, finally out of the box. Hear road events before they happen.

spotlight.name: Roof-rack spotlight
spotlight.text: A spotlight on the roof rack. Night driving sees farther.

long_tank.name: Long-range tank
long_tank.text: A second tank under the floor. Forty percent more road between fills.

mattress.name: Mattress in the back
mattress.text: June's drawing, built. Rest on the road without a motel. Dale folds.

scanner.name: Police scanner
scanner.text: A scanner under the dash. One free lead per case from intercepted calls.
